name: Underwater Ruins
author: Johburger
description: Skip the yellow gravity portal at 32%. Fall between the slopes as the wave at 34% and avoid the following spikes and saws. Avoid the invisible speed portal on the floor at 37% and then hold to the ceiling at 38%. Stop holding at 51% and fall to the floor between the spikes at 52%. Enter the ufo portal at the ceiling at 57%. Stay at the ceiling until 69% where you can then stay at the floor to the end.
